title: V3 RC2 Bug : Message new version available
symptom: Users receive a message stating that a new version is available, with warnings that closed loop will stop in a week and 14 days, even though they have the latest RC version installed (RC2 or RC3). The message appears once every 24 hours.
cause: The message appears once every 24 hours, depending on when the last version check was done, as explained by MilosKozak.
fix: No fix is provided in the thread; the maintainer explains the behavior but does not offer a solution.
evidence_quote: once in 24h. depends on when the last check was done
